# UX Requirements Checklist: 会话消息交互改进

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage of the user-facing interaction requirements  
**Created**: 2026-10-22  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` workflow based on the feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.  
**Marker Semantics**: Mark `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied; this does not mean implementation is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the expected labels and fallback content defined when the API has no usable model configuration? [Gap, Spec §US3, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Are keyboard operation and an accessible name explicitly specified for the Agent selector? [Gap, Spec §US3, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the narrow-window behavior defined beyond the requirement that controls do not overlap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is “model information corresponding to the selected Agent” sufficiently precise for both API and CLI options? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec clearly distinguish API as the built-in Agent from configured CLI choices? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the highlight duration and the rule for repeated matches stated consistently across requirements and success criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002–FR-003, SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do the requirements explain how users are informed when a compensating write also fails and the session Agent/default cannot be restored to the same state? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-007–FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Are Agent selection and shared permission settings clearly independent throughout all scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §US3, FR-008, SC-004]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are the behavior for unmatched todo text and deterministic selection among multiple matches complete for existing todos? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the no-current-session and running-state-transition cases fully represented in acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §US3, FR-007, FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can every success criterion be evaluated objectively without relying on implementation-specific details? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Notes

- All checklist items remain unchecked until reviewed by an independent reviewer.
- This checklist evaluates requirement quality only; it is not a test plan for implementation behavior.
